  <style>
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Regular.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 400; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Medium.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 500; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Bold.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 700; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    @font-face {
      font-family: 'Sweet Sans Pro';
      src: url('/fonts/SweetSansPro-Heavy.woff2') format('woff2');
      font-weight: 900; font-style: normal; font-display: swap;
    }
    :root {
      /* === light-mode lab palette === */
      --paper:        #f5f1e6;   /* warm cream background */
      --paper-deep:   #ede6d3;   /* slightly deeper for elevation */
      --card:         #fdfbf5;   /* slightly off-white card surface */
      --ink:          #15110a;   /* deep warm black */
      --ink-soft:     #2c271d;   /* dim ink */
      --ink-mute:     #6a6356;   /* mute */
      --ink-faint:    #98917f;   /* faint */
      --rule:         #d8d0bb;   /* hairline borders */
      --rule-strong:  #b8ae93;   /* stronger borders */
      --accent:       #8a6a2a;   /* deep ochre */
      --accent-warm:  #a08438;   /* warmer ochre for hover */
      --accent-faint: rgba(138,106,42,0.10);
      --accent-line:  rgba(138,106,42,0.30);
      --jade:         #2d6e6a;   /* secondary muted teal */
      --jade-faint:   rgba(45,110,106,0.08);
      --pulse:        #1d8a82;   /* live indicator */
      --cyan:         #0a726a;   /* security/trust accent (deep teal, AA on creme) */
      --cyan-faint:   rgba(10,114,106,0.10);
      --cyan-line:    rgba(10,114,106,0.30);
      --e-out:        cubic-bezier(0.23, 1, 0.32, 1);   /* airy ease-out for vectrfl-style sections */

      --font-display: 'Sweet Sans Pro', 'Inter', system-ui, -apple-system, sans-serif;
      --font-mono:    'IBM Plex Mono', ui-monospace, monospace;
      --ease:         cubic-bezier(0.19, 1, 0.22, 1);
      --ease-out:     cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
      --d-quick:      0.18s;
      --d-std:        0.3s;

      --grid-max:     1180px;
      --gutter:       clamp(1.25rem, 4vw, 4rem);

      /* === SPACING SCALE (4/8 grid). Use these, not ad-hoc rems === */
      --space-1: 0.25rem;   /* 4 */
      --space-2: 0.5rem;    /* 8 */
      --space-3: 0.75rem;   /* 12 */
      --space-4: 1rem;      /* 16 */
      --space-5: 1.5rem;    /* 24 */
      --space-6: 2rem;      /* 32 */
      --space-7: 3rem;      /* 48 */
      --space-8: 4rem;      /* 64 */
      --space-9: 6rem;      /* 96 */

      /* === TYPE SCALE (major-third, 1.25 ratio) === */
      --fs-display-1: clamp(2.25rem, 5.2vw, 4.25rem);  /* hero h1 */
      --fs-display-2: clamp(1.65rem, 3.6vw, 2.6rem);   /* h2 */
      --fs-display-3: clamp(1.2rem, 1.9vw, 1.5rem);    /* h3 */
      --fs-lead:      clamp(1rem, 1.4vw, 1.2rem);      /* hero-sub, lead, blurb, uc-desc, lab-body */
      --fs-body:      0.9375rem;                        /* 15px body */
      --fs-mono-xs:   0.625rem;   /* 10px. Eyebrow, table th, badge */
      --fs-mono-sm:   0.75rem;    /* 12px. Captions, status pills, footer links */
      --fs-mono-md:   0.8125rem;  /* 13px. Leaderboard td, arch-foot */
      --fs-mono-lg:   0.875rem;   /* 14px. Body alt, code blocks */

      /* === RADIUS SYSTEM === */
      --radius-pill:  999px;
      --radius-card:  8px;
      --radius-chip:  3px;
      --radius-sm:    4px;

      /* === SHADOW SYSTEM === */
      --shadow-sm: 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);
      --shadow-md: 0 4px 24px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.06);
      --shadow-lg: 0 12px 48px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.08), 0 2px 8px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.04);

      /* === NAV-INVERSE TOKENS ===
         The header always CONTRASTS the body. Light body -> dark header (below).
         Overridden under html.dark to flip to a light (creme) header. */
      --nav-bg:        #16120b;
      --nav-surface:   #221b10;
      --nav-ink:       #f4efe2;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #b3a98d;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(244,239,226,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #cda85f;
      --nav-cta-bg:    #a88c46;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #16120b;
      --nav-cta-hover: #c6a458;
    }

    /* === DARK MODE — warm on-brand palette (rule 46). Body tokens FLIP; nav tokens flip OPPOSITE (creme header). === */
    html.dark {
      --paper:        #100d07;
      --paper-deep:   #1a150c;
      --card:         #201a10;
      --ink:          #f2ede0;
      --ink-soft:     #d5cdba;
      --ink-mute:     #9a927e;
      --ink-faint:    #6e6656;
      --rule:         #2c2618;
      --rule-strong:  #403827;
      --accent:       #b08f45;
      --accent-warm:  #c6a458;
      --accent-faint: rgba(176,143,69,0.14);
      --accent-line:  rgba(176,143,69,0.30);
      /* the security accent lives on --cyan here (there is no --jade-deep/--accent-text in this page);
         map the warm-dark cyan onto the existing security tokens + --pulse */
      --cyan:         #36d8ca;
      --cyan-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --cyan-line:    rgba(54,216,202,0.30);
      --jade:         #36d8ca;
      --jade-faint:   rgba(54,216,202,0.12);
      --pulse:        #36d8ca;
      --shadow-sm:    0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,0.45);
      --shadow-md:    0 6px 26px rgba(0,0,0,0.5);
      --shadow-lg:    0 16px 50px rgba(0,0,0,0.55);

      /* nav flips to LIGHT (creme) header when the body is dark */
      --nav-bg:        #f5f1e6;
      --nav-surface:   #ede6d3;
      --nav-ink:       #16120b;
      --nav-ink-mute:  #6a6356;
      --nav-rule:      rgba(21,17,10,0.12);
      --nav-accent:    #6f5316; /* deep ochre: passes AA (5.9:1) as text on the creme header + makes the brain the strongest right-side glyph */
      --nav-cta-bg:    #16120b;
      --nav-cta-ink:   #f5f1e6;
      --nav-cta-hover: #2c271d;
    }

    *, *::before, *::after { margin: 0; padding: 0; box-sizing: border-box; }
    html { scroll-behavior: smooth; -webkit-font-smoothing: antialiased; -moz-osx-font-smoothing: grayscale; }
    body {
      background: var(--paper);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      line-height: 1.7;
      font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on, 'ss02' on, 'cv01' on, 'liga' on;
    }
    /* paper texture: very subtle warm noise via radial gradients */
    body::before {
      content: '';
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 50% at 8% 0%, rgba(138,106,42,0.04) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 50% 60% at 100% 100%, rgba(45,110,106,0.03) 0%, transparent 70%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 80% 80% at 50% 50%, transparent 60%, rgba(138,106,42,0.025) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }

    a { color: var(--accent); text-decoration: none; transition: color 0.2s var(--ease); }
    a:hover { color: var(--accent-warm); }
    a:focus-visible, button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
    .nav-hamburger:focus-visible, .nav-drawer-close:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent); outline-offset: 3px; border-radius: var(--radius-sm); }
    ::selection { background: var(--accent); color: var(--paper); }
    code {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.85em;
      color: var(--ink);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      padding: 0.1rem 0.35rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
    }

    /* === LAYOUT GRID === */
    .container {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: 0 var(--gutter);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .section {
      padding: clamp(4rem, 10vh, 9rem) 0;
      position: relative;
    }
    .rule {
      height: 1px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--rule-strong) 0%, var(--rule) 50%, transparent 100%);
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
    }

    /* === TYPOGRAPHY === */
    h1, h2, h3, h4 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-feature-settings: 'ss01' on, 'salt' on;
    }
    h1.display {
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: var(--fs-display-1);
      letter-spacing: -0.008em;
      line-height: 0.98;
    }
    h2 {
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: var(--fs-display-2);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.18;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-5);
      max-width: 32ch;
    }
    h3 {
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: var(--fs-display-3);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.3;
      color: var(--ink);
    }

    p {
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      max-width: 60ch;
    }
    p.lead {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 400;      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 50ch;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }
    p.body { line-height: 1.75; }
    p + p { margin-top: var(--space-3); }

    /* === SECTION LABEL (eyebrow) === */
    .eyebrow {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 3vh, 2.5rem);
    }
    /* Austere lab-document numerals: same mono treatment as the label */
    .eyebrow .num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-style: normal;
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
    }
    .eyebrow .line {
      flex-grow: 0;
      width: 2.5rem;
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--accent-line);
      transform-origin: left;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transition: transform 0.9s var(--ease) 0.3s;
    }
    .visible .eyebrow .line,
    .eyebrow.visible .line { transform: scaleX(1); }
    .eyebrow .label { white-space: nowrap; }
    .eyebrow .num,
    .eyebrow .label { transition: opacity 0.6s var(--ease) 0.15s; }

    /* === NAV === */
    .nav {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
      z-index: 100;
      padding: var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left)) var(--space-4) max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right));
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(14px) saturate(180%);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      transition: background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease, border-color .25s ease;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px), (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav {
        backdrop-filter: none;
        -webkit-backdrop-filter: none;
        background: var(--nav-bg);
      }
    }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .nav, .nav-drawer, .nav-cta-agent, .nav-social-icon, .nav-icon-link,
      .nav-theme-toggle, .nav-hamburger, .nav-drawer-close, .nav-drawer-links a,
      .nav-drawer-socials a, .drawer-theme-toggle {
        transition: none !important;
      }
    }
    .nav-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }
    .wordmark {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: color .25s ease;
    }
    .wordmark .brand-name { color: var(--nav-ink); }
    .wordmark .brand-mark {
      width: 0;
      height: 28px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      transition: width 0.3s var(--ease);
    }
    .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      width: 32px;
      background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo-light.png"); /* creme mark on the dark header (light mode) */
      background-size: contain;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-position: center;
    }
    html.dark .wordmark .brand-mark.has-logo {
      background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo.png"); /* dark mark on the creme header (dark mode) */
    }
    .wordmark .brand-name { display: inline-block; }

    /* --- Center: social icons --- */
    .nav-socials {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .nav-social-icon {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 32px;
      height: 32px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-social-icon:hover {
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      background: var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-social-icon svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* --- Right: page links + Meet the Agent CTA --- */
    .nav-links {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      align-items: center;
    }
    .nav-icon-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: 0.4rem;
      width: 34px;
      height: 34px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease), background 0.2s var(--ease);
      position: relative;
      background: transparent;
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover {
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      border-color: var(--nav-accent);
      background: var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-icon-link svg { width: 15px; height: 15px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; }
    /* connectome button — no ring, larger, brand gold so it stands out */
    .nav-brain { width: 40px; height: 40px; border: none; color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-brain svg { width: 26px; height: 26px; stroke-width: 1.9; }
    .nav-brain:hover { background: none; color: var(--nav-ink); transform: scale(1.08); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .nav-brain:hover { transform: none; } }

    /* Tooltip */
    .nav-icon-link::after {
      content: attr(data-tooltip);
      position: absolute;
      top: calc(100% + 8px);
      left: 50%;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(-4px);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-bg);
      background: var(--nav-ink);
      padding: 3px 8px;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      white-space: nowrap;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.15s var(--ease), transform 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-icon-link:hover::after {
      opacity: 1;
      transform: translateX(-50%) translateY(0);
    }

    /* --- Theme toggle (lightbulb). Shares the .nav-icon-link geometry/hit-area --- */
    .nav-theme-toggle {
      cursor: pointer;
      background: transparent;
      font: inherit;
    }
    .nav-theme-toggle svg {
      transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    /* Icon states: rays shown in LIGHT mode (bulb "on"), hidden in DARK mode */
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    /* filament brightens in light, dims to outline in dark */
    .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.9; transition: opacity 0.2s var(--ease); }
    html.dark .nav-theme-toggle .bulb-fill { opacity: 0.35; }
    @media (pointer: coarse) {
      .nav-theme-toggle { width: 44px; height: 44px; }
    }

    /* Meet the Agent CTA. Gradient flare */
    .nav-cta-agent {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      padding: var(--space-2) var(--space-5);
      min-height: 36px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-cta-ink);
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: var(--nav-cta-bg);
      transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease, color 0.22s ease;
      text-decoration: none;
    }
    /* keyframes retained — still used by body .btn-primary (unchanged) */
    @keyframes cta-shimmer {
      0%, 100% { background-position: 0% 50%; }
      50% { background-position: 100% 50%; }
    }
    .nav-cta-agent:hover {
      color: var(--nav-cta-ink);
      background: var(--nav-cta-hover);
      transform: translateY(-1px);
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.28), 0 2px 6px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.18);
    }
    @media (pointer: coarse) {
      .nav-cta-agent { min-height: 44px; }
    }

    /* --- Mobile: hide desktop links, show hamburger --- */
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .nav-socials { display: none; }
      .nav-links { display: none; }
      .nav-hamburger { display: flex; }
    }
    @media (min-width: 721px) {
      .nav-hamburger { display: none; }
      /* true-center the social icons at the middle of the header: 1fr | auto | 1fr
         puts the socials in a centered track flanked by equal-width side tracks */
      .nav-inner {
        display: grid;
        grid-template-columns: 1fr auto 1fr;
        align-items: center;
      }
      .nav-inner > .wordmark   { justify-self: start; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-socials { justify-self: center; }
      .nav-inner > .nav-links  { justify-self: end; }
    }

    /* --- Mobile hamburger button --- */
    .nav-hamburger {
      width: 38px;
      height: 38px;
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: var(--nav-surface);
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      cursor: pointer;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: 0;
      transition: color 0.22s var(--ease), border-color 0.22s var(--ease), background-color 0.22s ease;
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .nav-hamburger:hover,
    .nav-hamburger:focus-visible {
      border-color: var(--nav-accent);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
      outline: none;
    }
    .nav-hamburger svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }

    /* --- Mobile drawer --- */
    .nav-drawer-overlay {
      position: fixed;
      inset: 0;
      background: rgba(21, 17, 10, 0.4);
      z-index: 199;
      opacity: 0;
      pointer-events: none;
      transition: opacity 0.25s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-overlay.open {
      opacity: 1;
      pointer-events: auto;
    }
    .nav-drawer {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 0;
      width: min(320px, 85vw);
      background: var(--nav-bg);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
      z-index: 200;
      transform: translateX(100%);
      transition: transform 0.3s var(--ease), background-color .25s ease, color .25s ease;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      padding: var(--space-6) var(--space-5);
    }
    .nav-drawer.open {
      transform: translateX(0);
    }
    .nav-drawer-close {
      align-self: flex-end;
      width: 36px;
      height: 36px;
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      cursor: pointer;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-close:hover { border-color: var(--nav-accent); color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-close svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; stroke: currentColor; fill: none; stroke-width: 2; stroke-linecap: round; }
    .nav-drawer-links {
      list-style: none;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 4px;
    }
    .nav-drawer-links a {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-links a:hover {
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
    }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-cta { color: var(--nav-accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .nav-drawer-links .drawer-sep {
      height: 1px;
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      margin: var(--space-3) 0;
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: var(--space-6);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      width: 40px;
      height: 40px;
      color: var(--nav-ink-mute);
      border: 1px solid var(--nav-rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      transition: color 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .nav-drawer-socials a:hover { color: var(--nav-accent); border-color: var(--nav-accent); }
    .nav-drawer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* --- Drawer theme toggle row (matches drawer link geometry) --- */
    .drawer-theme-toggle {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      width: 100%;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--nav-ink);
      background: transparent;
      border: none;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      cursor: pointer;
      transition: background 0.15s var(--ease), color 0.15s var(--ease);
    }
    .drawer-theme-toggle:hover {
      background: var(--nav-rule);
      color: var(--nav-accent);
    }
    .drawer-theme-toggle svg { width: 18px; height: 18px; fill: none; stroke: currentColor; stroke-width: 1.5; stroke-linecap: round; stroke-linejoin: round; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 1; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .bulb-rays { opacity: 0; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: inline; }
    .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-dark { display: none; }
    html.dark .drawer-theme-toggle .label-light { display: inline; }

    /* Anchor jumps must clear the fixed nav. */
    section[id], .hero[id] {
      scroll-margin-top: 5rem;
    }

    /* === HERO (v7 2026-05-27: 2-col split. Text left, animated logo right) === */
    .hero {
      min-height: 100dvh;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      justify-content: center;
      padding: clamp(4rem, 8vh, 5.5rem) var(--gutter) clamp(2rem, 4.5vh, 3.25rem);
      position: relative;
      overflow: hidden;
    }
    .hero-inner { z-index: 1; }

    /* Hero logo. Animated video, square container, rounded corners,
       slight inset scale so the video bleeds under the rounded edges. */
    .hero-logo-stage {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 420px;
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-5);
    }
    .hero-logo {
      position: relative;
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
      aspect-ratio: 1 / 1;
      border-radius: 18px;
      overflow: hidden;
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      /* Border scales down on narrow phones so it doesn't dominate the
         260px container at 8px solid (review fix M-H2). */
      border: clamp(4px, 1.5vw, 8px) solid var(--ink);
      box-shadow:
        0 12px 36px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.10),
        0 4px 12px rgba(26, 24, 20, 0.05);
      opacity: 0;
      animation: hero-logo-in 1.1s var(--ease) 0.35s forwards;
    }
    .hero-logo video {
      width: 100%;
      height: 100%;
      display: block;
      object-fit: cover;
      /* Slight inset. Video bleeds under the rounded corners,
         giving the "slightly trimmed edges" treatment. */
      transform: scale(1.06);
      transform-origin: center;
    }
    @keyframes hero-logo-in {
      from { opacity: 0; transform: scale(0.96); }
      to   { opacity: 1; transform: scale(1); }
    }
    .hero::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      inset: 0;
      background:
        radial-gradient(ellipse 60% 70% at 88% 12%, rgba(138,106,42,0.08) 0%, transparent 60%),
        radial-gradient(ellipse 45% 55% at 4% 92%, rgba(45,110,106,0.05) 0%, transparent 60%);
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
    }
    /* HERO V8 (2026-05-27): 2-col grid. Text left (wider), static logo right. */
    .hero-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      width: 100%;
      margin: 0 auto;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1.35fr) minmax(0, 1fr);
      gap: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 5rem);
      align-items: center;
    }
    .hero-text {
      min-width: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      align-items: flex-start;
      gap: clamp(1rem, 2vh, 1.5rem);
      text-align: left;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hero {
        padding: clamp(5rem, 10vh, 5.75rem) var(--gutter) clamp(1.75rem, 4.5vh, 2.75rem);
      }
      .hero-inner {
        grid-template-columns: 1fr;
        gap: var(--space-6);
      }
      .hero-text {
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        /* Wrap text in a constrained column so it optically aligns with the
           320px logo below it (review fix M-H3). */
        max-width: 560px;
        margin: 0 auto;
      }
      .hero-logo-stage { max-width: 320px; }
    }
    /* Hero CTA + logo + meta should not push off-fold on phone landscape
       (review fix M-M6 / M-M5). Drops 100dvh enforcement when viewport is
       tight on height. */
    @media (max-height: 600px) and (orientation: landscape) {
      .hero { min-height: 0; padding-top: clamp(5rem, 10vh, 5.5rem); padding-bottom: clamp(1.5rem, 4vh, 2.5rem); }
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      /* Body text bump per mobile-review M-02 (16px floor). */
      body { font-size: 1rem; }
      :root { --fs-body: 1rem; }
      .hero-logo-stage { max-width: 260px; }
    }

    .hero-flag {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      padding: 0.4rem 0.95rem;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      background: var(--card);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.6875rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fade-up 0.8s var(--ease) 0.15s forwards;
    }
    .hero-flag .pulse {
      width: 6px;
      height: 6px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: var(--pulse);
      animation: pulse 2.4s var(--ease) infinite;
    }
    @keyframes pulse {
      0%, 100% { opacity: 0.4; transform: scale(1); }
      50%      { opacity: 1;   transform: scale(1.35); }
    }

    .hero h1.display { margin: 0; max-width: 30ch; }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hero h1.display { text-align: center; margin: 0 auto; }
    }
    .hero h1 .line {
      display: block;
      /* overflow hidden masks the 105% initial translateY so the word-rise
         reveal animation doesn't flash above-the-line on first paint
         (review fix U-H02 / M-M5). */
      overflow: hidden;
      line-height: 1.05;
    }
    .hero h1 .word {
      display: inline-block;
      transform: translateY(105%);
      opacity: 0;
      animation: word-rise 1.1s var(--ease) forwards;
      max-width: 100%;
    }
    .hero h1 .line:nth-child(1) .word { animation-delay: 0.30s; }
    .hero h1 .line:nth-child(2) .word { animation-delay: 0.45s; color: var(--accent); }

    .hero-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 400;      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.5vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.5;
      max-width: 48ch;
      margin: 0;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fade-up 0.9s var(--ease) 0.85s forwards;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hero-sub { text-align: center; margin: 0 auto; }
    }

    .hero-cta {
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fade-up 0.9s var(--ease) 1.05s forwards;
    }
    @media (max-width: 960px) {
      .hero-cta { justify-content: center; }
    }
    /* Mirror agent.html: full-width stacked CTAs on narrow phones so
       the two pills don't end up ragged-content-width (review fix
       M-M2). */
    @media (max-width: 520px) {
      .hero-cta { flex-direction: column; align-items: stretch; }
      .hero-cta .btn { width: 100%; max-width: 320px; margin: 0 auto; justify-content: center; }
    }

    /* buttons */
    .btn {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
      min-height: 48px;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      transition: all 0.22s var(--ease);
      cursor: pointer;
    }
    /* btn-primary unified to pill+shimmer system (matches /agent + nav-cta),
       resolving the two-system fork flagged in U-C06 review. */
    .btn-primary, .btn-secondary {
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    }
    .btn-primary {
      color: var(--paper);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #e3cd96 0%, var(--accent) 55%, #6a4f1f 100%);
      background-size: 200% 200%;
      animation: cta-shimmer 8s ease infinite;
      border: 1px solid transparent;
      box-shadow: 0 4px 16px rgba(138, 106, 42, 0.18);
    }
    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .btn-primary:hover {
        color: var(--paper);
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: 0 8px 26px rgba(138, 106, 42, 0.30), 0 3px 8px rgba(106, 79, 31, 0.20);
      }
    }
    .btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.97); }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .btn-primary { animation: none; }
    }
    .btn-ghost {
      background: transparent;
      color: var(--ink);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    }
    .btn-ghost:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .btn .arr { transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease); }
    .btn:hover .arr { transform: translateX(3px); }

    /* hero benchmark band */
    .hero-bench {
      margin: 0;
      padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      display: flex;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      align-items: baseline;
      justify-content: center;
      gap: clamp(0.5rem, 1.5vw, 1rem);
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 380px;
      text-align: center;
      opacity: 0;
      animation: fade-up 0.9s var(--ease) 1.3s forwards;
    }
    .hero-bench .num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: clamp(1.2rem, 2.2vw, 1.65rem);
      color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .hero-bench .meta {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .hero-bench .lnk {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      margin-left: auto;
      color: var(--accent);
      padding: var(--space-2) 0;
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      min-height: 44px;
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .hero-bench {
        flex-direction: column;
        /* Center-align the stacked bench inside the centered max-width
           container so the badge reads as a centered column not a
           ragged left edge (review fix M-C3). */
        align-items: center;
        text-align: center;
        gap: var(--space-2);
      }
      .hero-bench .meta { text-align: center; }
      .hero-bench .lnk { margin-left: 0; }
    }
    .hero-bench .lnk:hover { color: var(--accent-warm); }

    @keyframes word-rise { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } }
    @keyframes fade-up   { to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0); } from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(14px); } }

    /* === BENCHMARK SECTION === */
    .bench-headline {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: auto 1fr;
      align-items: stretch;
      gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 3rem);
      margin: var(--space-7) 0 2.5rem;
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.4rem);
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      position: relative;
    }
    .bench-headline::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; left: 0;
      width: 4px; height: 100%;
      background: var(--accent);
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .bench-headline { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-4); padding: 1.5rem; }
    }
    .bench-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 7vw, 4rem);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 0.92;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .bench-num sup {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: 0.28em;
      color: var(--accent);
      vertical-align: super;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      margin-left: 0.4rem;
    }
    .bench-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.55;
      align-self: center;
    }
    .bench-meta strong {
      display: block;
      font-weight: 600;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
      color: var(--ink);
    }
    .bench-meta .specs {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      margin-top: 0.7rem;
    }

    /* leaderboard */
    .leaderboard-wrap {
      overflow-x: auto;
      -webkit-overflow-scrolling: touch;
      margin: var(--space-5) 0;
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      background:
        linear-gradient(to right, var(--card) 30%, transparent),
        linear-gradient(to left, var(--card) 30%, transparent) 100% 0,
        linear-gradient(to right, rgba(0,0,0,0.06), transparent),
        linear-gradient(to left, rgba(0,0,0,0.06), transparent) 100% 0;
      background-repeat: no-repeat;
      background-size: 40px 100%, 40px 100%, 14px 100%, 14px 100%;
      background-attachment: local, local, scroll, scroll;
    }
    .leaderboard-wrap .leaderboard { margin: 0; min-width: 540px; }
    @media (max-width: 480px) {
      .leaderboard th, .leaderboard td { padding: 0.65rem 0.6rem; }
      .leaderboard td.arch { font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); }
    }
    .leaderboard {
      width: 100%;
      border-collapse: collapse;
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
    }
    .leaderboard th, .leaderboard td {
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      text-align: left;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      vertical-align: middle;
    }
    .leaderboard th {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.625rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
    }
    .leaderboard td.rk {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--ink-faint);
      width: 3.5rem;
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
    }
    .leaderboard td.score {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .leaderboard td.arch {
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
    }
    .leaderboard tr.us td {
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      color: var(--ink);
    }
    .leaderboard tr.us td.rk { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .leaderboard tr.us td.score { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .leaderboard tr.us td.arch { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500; }
    .leaderboard tr.us strong { color: var(--accent); font-weight: 600; }
    .leaderboard tr.below td {
      font-style: italic;
      color: var(--ink-faint);
      text-align: center;
      padding: 0.95rem;
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      background: transparent;
    }

    /* category breakdown */
    .cat-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 0.65rem;
      margin-top: var(--space-7);
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .cat-grid { grid-template-columns: repeat(6, 1fr); } }
    .cat-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-3);
      text-align: center;
      transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease), border-color 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .cat-card:hover { transform: translateY(-2px); border-color: var(--accent-line); }
    .cat-card.perfect {
      border-top-color: var(--jade);
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, var(--jade-faint) 0%, var(--card) 70%);
    }
    .cat-card .cat-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: var(--accent);
      line-height: 1;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .cat-card.perfect .cat-num { color: var(--jade); }
    .cat-card .cat-name {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      margin-top: 0.45rem;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* pull quote */
    .quote {
      margin: 3rem 0 1rem;
      padding: var(--space-5) 2rem;
      border-left: 3px solid var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      border-radius: 0 4px 4px 0;
      max-width: 760px;
    }
    .quote p {
      /* Sweet Sans Pro has no italic file. Drop synthetic italic, lean on
         display family + slight color shift (review fix U-C04). */
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.55vw, 1.25rem);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.5;
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      max-width: none;
    }
    .quote footer {
      margin-top: 0.95rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
    }

    .text-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      margin-top: 2rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-5);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.2s var(--ease);
    }
    .text-link:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
    }
    .text-link:hover .arr { transform: translateX(3px); }

    /* === PRODUCT CARDS === */
    .product-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-5);
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 860px) { .product-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 1.75rem; } }

    .product-card {
      position: relative;
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.25rem);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      transition: all 0.3s var(--ease);
    }
    .product-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-line);
      transform: translateY(-3px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 36px rgba(20,17,10,0.06);
    }
    .product-card .badge {
      align-self: flex-start;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      padding: 0.32rem 0.7rem;
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
    }
    .product-card h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 600;      font-size: clamp(1.4rem, 2.3vw, 1.9rem);
      letter-spacing: -0.008em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .product-card .blurb {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: 1rem;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 38ch;
    }
    .product-card .specs {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.55rem;
      padding: 1rem 0;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
    }
    .product-card .specs .spec {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .product-card .specs .spec .v {
      color: var(--ink);
      font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums;
    }
    .product-card .price-line {
      display: flex;
      align-items: baseline;
      gap: 0.5rem;
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;    }
    .product-card .price-line .from {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      font-weight: 500;
    }
    .product-card .price-line .price {
      font-size: 1.4rem;
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
    }
    .product-card .price-line .price-end {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.05em;
    }
    .product-card .cta-row {
      display: flex;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: auto;
      padding-top: 0.5rem;
    }

    /* === USE CASES (numbered list, editorial) === */
    .uc-list {
      margin-top: var(--space-7);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    .uc-row {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 4rem 1fr auto;
      gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      align-items: baseline;
      padding: var(--space-5) 0;
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      transition: background 0.25s var(--ease);
    }
    .uc-row:hover { background: var(--accent-faint); }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .uc-row {
        grid-template-columns: 2.5rem 1fr;
        grid-template-rows: auto auto;
        column-gap: var(--space-3);
        row-gap: var(--space-3);
      }
      .uc-row .uc-num { grid-column: 1; grid-row: 1; }
      .uc-row .uc-body { grid-column: 2; grid-row: 1; }
      .uc-row .uc-status {
        grid-column: 1 / -1;
        grid-row: 2;
        justify-self: start;
        margin-top: 0;
        margin-left: calc(2.5rem + var(--space-3));
      }
    }
    .uc-row .uc-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: 1.2rem;
      color: var(--ink-faint);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      font-feature-settings: 'lnum' on, 'tnum' on;
    }
    .uc-row .uc-body h3 {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 1.95vw, 1.55rem);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.2;
      margin-bottom: 0.45rem;
    }
    .uc-row .uc-target {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.7rem;
      display: block;
    }
    .uc-row .uc-desc {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 56ch;
      margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }
    .uc-row .uc-buyers {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .uc-row .uc-buyers strong { color: var(--ink); font-weight: 500; }
    .uc-row .uc-status {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      padding: 0.32rem 0.75rem;
      border-radius: var(--radius-pill);
      white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .status-live  { background: var(--jade-faint);   color: var(--jade);   border: 1px solid rgba(45,110,106,0.25); }
    .status-pilot { background: var(--accent-faint); color: var(--accent); border: 1px solid var(--accent-line); }
    .status-soon  { background: transparent;          color: var(--ink-mute); border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong); }

    /* === ARCHITECTURE === */
    .arch-block {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.5rem);
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    .arch-block .head {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.625rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
    .tier-strip {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
      gap: 0.55rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .tier-strip { grid-template-columns: repeat(5, 1fr); } }
    .tier {
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-top: 2px solid var(--accent);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: var(--space-4) var(--space-3);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.3rem;
    }
    .tier .tier-name {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;      font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      letter-spacing: 0.08em;
    }
    /* Restrained palette. Ochre intensity gradient + jade for ARCHIVE.
       No off-brand hues. Differentiation is by weight/brightness within
       the brand palette, not by chromatic explosion. */
    .tier .tier-name.hot   { color: var(--accent-warm); }
    .tier .tier-name.warm  { color: var(--accent); }
    .tier .tier-name.cold  { color: var(--ink-soft); }
    .tier .tier-name.ref   { color: var(--ink-mute); }
    .tier .tier-name.arch  { color: var(--jade); }
    .tier .tier-tables {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.4;
    }
    .tier .tier-desc {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.625rem;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      line-height: 1.45;
    }

    .flow-row {
      margin-top: 1.5rem;
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      flex-wrap: wrap;
      gap: 0.65rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.75rem;
      color: var(--ink);
    }
    .flow-row .flow-arrow { color: var(--accent); }
    .flow-row .flow-pg    { color: var(--accent); }

    .arch-foot {
      margin-top: 1rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: 80ch;
    }

    .arch-callouts {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      margin-top: 2rem;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .arch-callouts { grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr); } }
    .arch-callout {
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
      padding: 1.35rem 1.5rem;
    }
    .arch-callout .head {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.625rem;
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: 0.55rem;
    }
    .arch-callout p {
      margin: 0;
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
      line-height: 1.65;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      max-width: none;
    }

    /* === OVERVIEW: TERRITORY / RESEARCH / METHOD / OPEN === */
    .territory-list {
      margin: var(--space-6) 0;
      display: grid;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      max-width: 56ch;
    }
    .territory-item {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: var(--fs-lead);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.5;
      display: flex;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .territory-item .t-num {
      color: var(--accent);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .closing-note {
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      /* italic dropped per U-C04; color softness + display family carry
         the editorial-note feel. */
      font-size: var(--fs-lead);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      max-width: 56ch;
    }

    .research-grid {
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(280px, 1fr));
      gap: var(--space-4);
    }
    .research-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: var(--space-5);
      transition: all 0.25s var(--ease);
    }
    .research-card:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent-line);
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .research-card h3 {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .research-card .r-tag {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }
    .research-card .r-desc {
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.65;
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }
    .research-card .r-link {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      margin-top: var(--space-3);
      padding-top: var(--space-3);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      width: 100%;
    }
    .research-card .r-link .arr { transition: transform 0.2s var(--ease); }
    .research-card .r-link:hover .arr { transform: translateX(3px); }

    .method-list {
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
      display: grid;
      gap: var(--space-6);
      max-width: 64ch;
    }
    .method-item h3 {
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .method-item p {
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--ink-soft);
    }

    .open-list {
      margin: var(--space-6) 0;
      padding: 0;
      list-style: none;
      counter-reset: open;
      display: grid;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      max-width: 60ch;
    }
    .open-list li {
      counter-increment: open;
      padding-left: var(--space-7);
      position: relative;
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: var(--fs-lead);
      color: var(--ink);
      line-height: 1.55;
    }
    .open-list li::before {
      content: "0" counter(open);
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0.4rem;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.2em;
      color: var(--accent);
    }

    .doors {
      margin-top: var(--space-5);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      max-width: 56ch;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) {
      .doors { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
    }
    .door {
      padding: var(--space-4);
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
    }
    .door h3 {
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .door p {
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.65;
    }

    /* === LAB SECTION (drop cap, editorial) === */
    .lab-body {
      max-width: 62ch;
    }
    .lab-body p {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: clamp(1.025rem, 1.4vw, 1.15rem);
      line-height: 1.7;
      color: var(--ink);
      max-width: none;
    }
    .lab-body p + p { margin-top: 1.1rem; }
    .lab-body p:first-of-type::first-letter {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 700;      font-size: 4.2rem;
      line-height: 0.85;
      float: left;
      margin: 0.3rem 0.6rem 0 0;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .lab-body p:first-of-type::first-letter {
        font-size: 3rem;
        margin: 0.2rem 0.4rem 0 0;
      }
    }
    .lab-marginalia {
      margin-top: var(--space-7);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 0.7rem;
      max-width: 56ch;
      padding-top: 1.5rem;
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .lab-marginalia { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; } }
    .lab-marginalia a {
      display: flex;
      justify-content: space-between;
      gap: var(--space-4);
      padding: 0.55rem 0;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.04em;
      color: var(--ink);
      border-bottom: 1px dashed var(--rule);
      transition: color 0.2s, padding 0.2s;
    }
    .lab-marginalia a:hover {
      color: var(--accent);
      padding-left: 0.4rem;
    }
    .lab-marginalia a .ext {
      color: var(--ink-faint);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
    }

    /* === CONTACT === */
    .contact-block {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: clamp(2rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: 2rem;
      align-items: center;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) { .contact-block { grid-template-columns: 1fr auto; } }
    .contact-block h2 { margin-bottom: 0.6rem; }
    .contact-block .contact-sub {
      font-family: var(--font-display);      font-size: clamp(0.95rem, 1.3vw, 1.1rem);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.55;
      max-width: 48ch;
    }
    .contact-cta-stack {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: 0.65rem;
    }
    .contact-link {
      display: flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: var(--space-3) var(--space-4);
      min-height: 48px;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule-strong);
      border-radius: var(--radius-chip);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.12em;
      color: var(--ink);
      transition: all 0.2s var(--ease);
      width: 100%;
    }
    @media (min-width: 760px) {
      .contact-link { width: auto; min-width: 280px; }
    }
    .contact-link:hover {
      border-color: var(--accent);
      background: var(--accent-faint);
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .contact-link .icon {
      width: 16px;
      height: 16px;
      flex-shrink: 0;
      stroke: currentColor;
      stroke-width: 1.5;
      fill: none;
    }
    .contact-link .label {
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      letter-spacing: 0.22em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      margin-right: 0.35rem;
    }

    /* === FOOTER === */
    .footer {
      padding:
        clamp(3rem, 7vh, 5rem)
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-right))
        max(clamp(2rem, 5vh, 3rem), env(safe-area-inset-bottom))
        max(var(--gutter), env(safe-area-inset-left));
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
    }
    .footer-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: 1fr;
      gap: clamp(2.5rem, 6vw, 4rem);
      align-items: start;
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-inner { grid-template-columns: 1.5fr 1fr; } }

    /* brand block */
    .footer-brand { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-3); max-width: 34rem; }
    .footer-logo { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.6rem; text-decoration: none; }
    .footer-mark {
      width: 30px; height: 30px; flex-shrink: 0;
      background: url("/sibyl-labs-logo.png") center / contain no-repeat; /* dark mark on the creme footer */
    }
    html.dark .footer-mark { background-image: url("/sibyl-labs-logo-light.png"); } /* creme mark on the dark footer */
    .footer-wordmark {
      font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600; font-size: var(--fs-mono-lg);
      letter-spacing: 0.16em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink);
    }
    .footer-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; line-height: 1.7; margin: 0;
    }
    .footer-socials { display: flex; gap: var(--space-3); margin-top: var(--space-2); }
    .footer-socials a {
      width: 40px; height: 40px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
      border: 1px solid var(--rule); border-radius: 999px; color: var(--ink-mute);
      transition: color .2s var(--ease), border-color .2s var(--ease), transform .2s var(--ease);
    }
    .footer-socials a:hover { color: var(--accent); border-color: var(--accent); transform: translateY(-2px); }
    .footer-socials svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; fill: currentColor; }

    /* link columns */
    .footer-nav { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(2, minmax(8rem, 1fr)); gap: clamp(1.5rem, 4vw, 2.75rem); }
    @media (min-width: 768px) { .footer-nav { justify-self: end; } }
    .footer-col { display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
    .footer-col-head {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); letter-spacing: 0.2em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-faint); margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .footer-col a {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm); color: var(--ink-mute);
      letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-decoration: none; padding: 0.4rem 0; min-height: 40px;
      display: inline-flex; align-items: center; transition: color .2s var(--ease);
    }
    .footer-col a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    /* bottom bar */
    .footer-bar {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: clamp(2.5rem, 5vh, 3.5rem) auto 0; padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: var(--space-2) var(--space-5); align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
    }
    .footer-legal, .footer-agent {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); color: var(--ink-faint); letter-spacing: 0.04em;
    }
    .footer-agent a { color: var(--ink-mute); transition: color .2s var(--ease); }
    .footer-agent a:hover { color: var(--accent); }

    /* === SCROLL REVEAL (elevated: 40px rise, strong airy ease-out) === */
    .reveal {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(40px);
      transition: opacity 0.9s var(--e-out), transform 0.9s var(--e-out);
      will-change: opacity, transform;
    }
    .reveal.visible { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
    .reveal.visible { will-change: auto; }

    /* Sequenced reveal: a container whose direct children cascade in when it
       enters view (headline -> subhead -> items). The container itself does
       not move; only its children stagger. Keeps choreography calm + readable. */
    .reveal-seq > * {
      opacity: 0;
      transform: translateY(30px);
      transition: opacity 0.85s var(--e-out), transform 0.85s var(--e-out);
      will-change: opacity, transform;
    }
    .reveal-seq.visible > * { opacity: 1; transform: none; will-change: auto; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(1) { transition-delay: 0s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(2) { transition-delay: 0.08s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(3) { transition-delay: 0.16s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(4) { transition-delay: 0.24s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(5) { transition-delay: 0.32s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(6) { transition-delay: 0.40s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(7) { transition-delay: 0.48s; }
    .reveal-seq.visible > *:nth-child(n+8) { transition-delay: 0.54s; }

    /* === SCROLL PROGRESS HAIRLINE (ochre -> cyan) === */
    .scroll-progress {
      position: fixed;
      top: 0; left: 0;
      height: 2px;
      width: 100%;
      transform: scaleX(0);
      transform-origin: 0 50%;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, var(--accent) 0%, var(--accent-warm) 45%, var(--cyan) 100%);
      z-index: 250;
      pointer-events: none;
    }

    /* When JS inertia smooth-scroll is active, disable native smooth so the
       lerp is the single source of scroll motion (no double-easing). */
    html.lenis-on { scroll-behavior: auto; }

    /* === REDUCED MOTION === */
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      html { scroll-behavior: auto; }
      *, *::before, *::after {
        animation-duration: 0.01ms !important;
        animation-delay: 0ms !important;
        transition-duration: 0.01ms !important;
      }
      .reveal { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      .reveal-seq > * { opacity: 1 !important; transform: none !important; }
      .hero h1 .word { opacity: 1; transform: none; }
      .scroll-progress { display: none; }
    }
    /* ============================================================
       PRODUCT SHOWCASE: Sibyl Memory Plugin (2026-05-27)
       Replaces hero-video-section. CLI screenshot + dark-mode spec
       diagram + Bounty Board callout.
       ============================================================ */
    .product-showcase {
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }

    /* CLI banner as section header. No terminal chrome, just the image
       framed cleanly at top of the product-showcase section. */
    .cli-header {
      width: 100%;
      max-width: 1080px;
      margin: 0 auto clamp(2.5rem, 5vh, 4rem);
      border-radius: 12px;
      overflow: hidden;
      border: 1px solid rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.22);
      box-shadow:
        0 24px 64px rgba(15, 12, 8, 0.20),
        0 4px 16px rgba(15, 12, 8, 0.10);
      background: #0f0c08;
    }
    .cli-header img {
      width: 100%;
      height: auto;
      display: block;
    }
    /* CLI banner is 2.6:1 wide; on phones it renders ~128px tall and the
       wordmark glyphs lose readability. Force a floor height + center-crop
       the wordmark for ≤640px (review fix M-H1). */
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .cli-header { height: 200px; }
      .cli-header img {
        width: auto;
        height: 100%;
        min-width: 100%;
        object-fit: cover;
        object-position: center;
      }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       DARK-MODE SPEC DIAGRAM. Focal element on creme page
       ============================================================ */
    .dark-diagram {
      position: relative;
      margin: clamp(3rem, 7vh, 5rem) auto 0;
      max-width: 1080px;
      padding: clamp(2.5rem, 6vh, 4rem) clamp(1.5rem, 5vw, 3.5rem);
      background: linear-gradient(135deg, #0e0b07 0%, #1a1410 55%, #211a12 100%);
      border: 1px solid rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.22);
      border-radius: 16px;
      box-shadow:
        0 32px 80px rgba(15, 12, 8, 0.32),
        0 8px 24px rgba(15, 12, 8, 0.16);
      overflow: hidden;
      isolation: isolate;
    }
    .dd-glow {
      position: absolute;
      pointer-events: none;
      z-index: 0;
      border-radius: 50%;
      filter: blur(80px);
    }
    .dd-glow-a {
      top: -25%;
      right: -10%;
      width: 55%;
      height: 70%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.22) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }
    .dd-glow-b {
      bottom: -25%;
      left: -10%;
      width: 50%;
      height: 65%;
      background: radial-gradient(circle, rgba(45, 138, 130, 0.16) 0%, transparent 60%);
    }
    .dd-header {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      text-align: center;
      margin-bottom: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 3rem);
    }
    .dd-logo {
      display: block;
      width: clamp(64px, 8vw, 88px);
      height: auto;
      margin: 0 auto var(--space-5);
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 24px rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.35)) drop-shadow(0 4px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4));
    }
    .dd-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;
      font-size: clamp(1.5rem, 3vw, 2.1rem);
      color: #f5f1e6;
      margin: 0 0 var(--space-3);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
    }
    .dd-tagline {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-md);
      color: #a39a82;
      max-width: 42ch;
      margin: 0 auto;
      letter-spacing: 0.02em;
    }
    .dd-columns {
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: 0;
    }
    .dd-col {
      padding: 0 clamp(1rem, 2.5vw, 1.75rem);
      border-left: 1px solid rgba(245, 241, 230, 0.08);
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .dd-col:first-child { border-left: none; padding-left: 0; }
    .dd-col:last-child  { padding-right: 0; }
    .dd-letter {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(2.5rem, 5vw, 3.75rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      line-height: 1;
      color: #c4a862;
      letter-spacing: -0.02em;
      filter: drop-shadow(0 0 16px rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.25));
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .dd-cat {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.28em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: #f5f1e6;
      padding-bottom: var(--space-3);
      border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(245, 241, 230, 0.12);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-2);
    }
    .dd-list,
    .dd-steps {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-3);
    }
    .dd-list li,
    .dd-steps li {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: 0.8125rem;
      color: rgba(245, 241, 230, 0.78);
      line-height: 1.6;
      position: relative;
      padding-left: 1.1rem;
    }
    .dd-list li::before {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0.55em;
      width: 5px;
      height: 5px;
      border-radius: 50%;
      background: #c4a862;
      opacity: 0.65;
    }
    .dd-list li strong,
    .dd-steps li strong {
      color: #f5f1e6;
      font-weight: 600;
    }
    .dd-steps { counter-reset: ddstep; }
    .dd-steps li {
      counter-increment: ddstep;
      padding-left: 1.6rem;
    }
    .dd-steps li::before {
      content: counter(ddstep);
      position: absolute;
      left: 0;
      top: 0;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      color: #c4a862;
      letter-spacing: 0.1em;
    }
    .dd-col-cta {
      background: linear-gradient(180deg, rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.04) 0%, rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.10) 100%);
      border-radius: 10px;
      padding: var(--space-5) clamp(1.2rem, 2vw, 1.75rem);
      margin-left: -0.5rem;
      margin-right: -0.5rem;
      border-left: 1px solid rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.2);
    }
    .dd-col-cta .dd-cat { border-bottom-color: rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.18); }
    .dd-cta {
      display: inline-flex;
      align-items: center;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding: 0.85rem 1.4rem;
      margin-top: var(--space-3);
      background: #c4a862;
      color: #1a1410;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      text-decoration: none;
      border-radius: 4px;
      transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease), background 0.22s var(--ease), box-shadow 0.22s var(--ease);
      align-self: flex-start;
      min-height: 44px;
    }
    .dd-cta:hover {
      background: #e3cd96;
      transform: translateY(-2px);
      box-shadow: 0 12px 32px rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.28);
    }
    .dd-cta-arr { transition: transform 0.22s var(--ease); }
    .dd-cta:hover .dd-cta-arr { transform: translateX(4px); }

    /* Push 1-col stack to ≤768 so iPad portrait + 721-768 band don't show
       cramped 3-col layout (review fix M-C2). */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .dd-columns { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-6); }
      .dd-col { border-left: none; padding: var(--space-4) 0 0; border-top: 1px solid rgba(245, 241, 230, 0.08); }
      .dd-col:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 0; }
      .dd-col-cta { margin: 0; padding: var(--space-5) var(--space-5); border-top: 1px solid rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.2); border-left: 1px solid rgba(196, 168, 98, 0.2); }
      /* Letters become section-headers in stack mode, restore visual weight */
      .dd-letter { font-size: clamp(2.75rem, 7vw, 3.5rem); }
    }

    /* Bounty Board callout. Distinct, accent-tinted band */
    .bounty-board {
      margin-top: clamp(2.5rem, 6vh, 4rem);
      padding: clamp(2rem, 4vh, 3rem);
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--accent-line);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      border-left: 4px solid var(--accent);
      box-shadow: var(--shadow-sm);
    }
    .bounty-board-head {
      margin-bottom: var(--space-6);
    }
    .bb-eyebrow {
      display: inline-block;
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.32em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
      margin-bottom: var(--space-3);
    }
    .bb-title {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-size: clamp(1.35rem, 2.2vw, 1.75rem);
      font-weight: 500;
      color: var(--ink);
      max-width: 36ch;
      margin: 0;
    }
    .bounty-board-list {
      list-style: none;
      padding: 0;
      margin: 0;
      display: grid;
      /* 4-up by default, balanced 2x2 on tablets, 1-col on phones. The
         prior auto-fit produced orphaned items in the 720-880 band
         (review fix M-M1). */
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
    }
    @media (max-width: 1024px) {
      .bounty-board-list { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
    }
    .bounty-board-list li {
      display: flex;
      flex-direction: column;
      gap: var(--space-2);
      padding-left: var(--space-4);
      border-left: 1px solid var(--rule);
    }
    .bb-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      font-weight: 600;
      letter-spacing: 0.16em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink);
    }
    .bb-desc {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      line-height: 1.5;
    }
    .bb-note {
      margin-top: var(--space-5);
      padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--rule);
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      text-align: center;
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .bounty-board-list { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
      .bounty-board-list li { border-left: none; padding-left: 0; padding-top: var(--space-3); border-top: 1px solid var(--rule); }
      .bounty-board-list li:first-child { border-top: none; padding-top: 0; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       PROOF STRIP (ported from /agent 2026-05-26)
       ============================================================ */
    .proof-strip {
      background: var(--card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .proof-strip-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max);
      margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--space-6) var(--gutter);
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
      align-items: center;
    }
    .proof-item { text-align: center; }
    .proof-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display);
      font-weight: 500;      font-size: clamp(1.05rem, 1.6vw, 1.4rem);
      color: var(--ink);
      letter-spacing: -0.005em;
      line-height: 1.1;
    }
    .proof-label {
      font-family: var(--font-mono);
      font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.18em;
      text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      margin-top: var(--space-2);
    }
    @media (max-width: 720px) {
      .proof-strip-inner { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); gap: var(--space-5) var(--space-4); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       BENCHMARK BANNER (scrolling proof strip, bottom of hero)
       ============================================================ */
    .bench-banner {
      background: var(--card);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      overflow: hidden;
      position: relative;
      z-index: 1;
      padding: var(--space-4) 0;
    }
    .bench-banner::before, .bench-banner::after {
      content: ''; position: absolute; top: 0; bottom: 0; width: clamp(40px, 8vw, 96px);
      z-index: 2; pointer-events: none;
    }
    .bench-banner::before { left: 0;  background: linear-gradient(90deg,  var(--card), transparent); }
    .bench-banner::after  { right: 0; background: linear-gradient(270deg, var(--card), transparent); }
    .bench-track {
      display: flex;
      width: max-content;
      animation: bench-scroll 42s linear infinite;
    }
    .bench-banner:hover .bench-track { animation-play-state: paused; }
    .bench-set { display: flex; align-items: center; flex-shrink: 0; }
    .bench-item {
      display: inline-flex; align-items: baseline; gap: var(--space-3);
      padding: 0 var(--space-6); white-space: nowrap;
    }
    .bench-num {
      font-family: var(--font-display); font-weight: 600;
      font-size: clamp(1.1rem, 1.8vw, 1.5rem); color: var(--accent);
      letter-spacing: -0.01em;
    }
    .bench-txt {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      letter-spacing: 0.14em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--ink-mute);
    }
    .bench-sep { color: var(--rule-strong); font-size: 0.55rem; align-self: center; }
    @keyframes bench-scroll { from { transform: translateX(0); } to { transform: translateX(-50%); } }
    @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
      .bench-track { animation: none; width: 100%; justify-content: center; flex-wrap: wrap; }
      .bench-set[aria-hidden="true"] { display: none; }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       INFRASTRUCTURE BANNER ("built on")
       ============================================================ */
    .infra-banner {
      background: var(--paper-deep);
      border-top: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-bottom: 1px solid var(--rule);
      position: relative; z-index: 1;
    }
    .infra-inner {
      max-width: var(--grid-max); margin: 0 auto;
      padding: var(--space-5) var(--gutter);
      display: flex; align-items: center;
      gap: clamp(1rem, 4vw, 3rem);
    }
    .infra-eyebrow {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs); font-weight: 500;
      letter-spacing: 0.32em; text-transform: uppercase; color: var(--accent);
      flex-shrink: 0;
    }
    .infra-logos {
      flex: 1 1 auto; display: flex; align-items: center;
      justify-content: space-around; gap: clamp(1rem, 3vw, 2.5rem); flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .infra-logo {
      display: inline-block; width: 40px; height: 30px;
      background-color: var(--ink-mute);
      -webkit-mask: var(--logo) center / contain no-repeat;
              mask: var(--logo) center / contain no-repeat;
      transition: background-color .25s var(--ease), transform .25s var(--ease);
      opacity: 0.92;
    }
    .infra-logo:hover { background-color: var(--accent); opacity: 1; transform: translateY(-1px); }
    @media (max-width: 640px) {
      .infra-inner { flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4); }
      .infra-logos { justify-content: center; gap: clamp(1.5rem, 6vw, 2.5rem); }
    }
    .infra-banner + #work.tabs-section { padding-top: clamp(3rem, 7vh, 5rem); }
    .bench-banner + .infra-banner { border-top: none; }

    /* ============================================================
       FEATURES GRID (3-card pattern, ported from /agent)
       ============================================================ */
    .features-grid {
      display: grid;
      grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
      gap: var(--space-5);
      margin-top: var(--space-6);
    }
    .feature-card {
      background: var(--card);
      border: 1px solid var(--rule);
      border-radius: var(--radius-card);
      padding: var(--space-6);
      display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: var(--space-4);
      transition: transform var(--d-std) var(--ease-out), box-shadow var(--d-std) var(--ease-out), border-color var(--d-std) var(--ease-out);
    }
    @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
      .feature-card:hover {
        transform: translateY(-3px);
        box-shadow: var(--shadow-lg);
        border-color: var(--accent-line);
      }
    }
    .feature-card .feature-num {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-xs);
      font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: 0.22em; text-transform: uppercase;
      color: var(--accent);
    }
    .feature-card h3 {
      margin-bottom: 0;
      font-size: clamp(1.15rem, 1.7vw, 1.4rem);
    }
    .feature-card p {
      color: var(--ink-soft);
      font-size: var(--fs-body);
      line-height: 1.7;
      max-width: none;
      /* Take up remaining space so feature-meta bottom-aligns across the
         row without the prior h3 min-height hack (review fix U-H03). */
      flex: 1;
    }
    .feature-card .feature-meta {
      font-family: var(--font-mono); font-size: var(--fs-mono-sm);
      color: var(--ink-mute);
      padding-top: var(--space-4);
      border-top: 1px dashed var(--rule);
      display: flex; gap: var(--space-2); align-items: baseline; flex-wrap: wrap;
      margin-top: auto;
    }
    .feature-card .feature-meta strong {
      color: var(--accent); font-weight: 500;
    }
    /* Stack at ≤768 (unified with dd-columns breakpoint per M-C2). */
    @media (max-width: 768px) {
      .features-grid { grid-template-columns: 1fr; gap: var(--space-4); }
    }

    /* ============================================================
       TABS (animated card system, ported from /agent)
