       ============================================================ */
    .tabs-section { padding-top: clamp(3rem, 8vh, 6rem); padding-bottom: clamp(3rem, 8vh, 6rem); }
    /* Tighter top padding when tabs-section follows the proof-strip. The
       proof-strip already acts as a visual divider (U-04 review fix). */
    .proof-strip + .tabs-section { padding-top: clamp(2rem, 5vh, 3.5rem); }
    .tabs-wrap { margin-top: var(--space-6); }
    /* Wrap tab-bar in a positioning context for the right-edge fade
       gradient (review fix M-H4 / A-H4): cuts-off tabs at narrow width
       are signalled by a fade chevron the user can scroll past. */
    .tab-bar-wrap { position: relative; }
    .tab-bar-wrap::after {
      content: '';
      position: absolute;
      top: 0; right: 0; bottom: 1px;
      width: 32px;
      background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent 0%, var(--paper) 100%);
      pointer-events: none;
      opacity: 0;
      transition: opacity var(--d-quick) var(--ease-out);
    }
    .tab-bar-wrap.has-overflow::after { opacity: 1; }
    .tab-bar {
      position: relative;

    (function () {
      var reduce = window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
      var progress = document.getElementById('scroll-progress');
      var ctaSection = document.querySelector('.vx-cta');

      var heroEls = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax="hero"]').forEach(function (el) {
        heroEls.push({ el: el, speed: parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-speed')) || 0 });
      });
      var ctaEls = [];
      document.querySelectorAll('[data-parallax="section"]').forEach(function (el) {
        ctaEls.push({ el: el, speed: parseFloat(el.getAttribute('data-speed')) || 0 });
      });

      // ----- signature scroll-stack (three products) -----
      var stackTrack = document.getElementById('stack-track');
      var stackList  = document.getElementById('stack-list');
      var stackFill  = document.getElementById('stack-rail-fill');
      var stackItems = [];
      var stackMode = null, stackTop = 0, stackRange = 0, stackN = 0;

      // merged hero+stack (redraft-d)
      var stackSticky = document.getElementById('stack-sticky');
      var heroStage   = document.getElementById('hero-stage');
      var stackStage  = document.getElementById('stack-stage');
      var stackHead   = document.getElementById('stack-head');
      var REVEAL_VH = 0.6;                 // reveal segment, in viewport-heights of scroll
      var PANEL_VH  = 0.85;                // per-panel accordion segment (unchanged)
      var HERO_LEAD = 0.85;                // hero exits at 85% of the reveal segment
      var revealEnd = 0, stageY0 = 0;

      // Gate: choose the stack behaviour for this device. The mechanic is now
      // decoupled from the (desktop-only) smooth-scroll lerp below.
      //  - 'pin'  = desktop pointer + wide + tall viewport: sticky pinned stage,
      //             scroll drives the sequential expand (UNCHANGED behaviour).
      //  - 'flow' = touch / small viewport (motion allowed): non-pinned
      //             expand-on-enter, each bar expands as it enters the viewport,
      //             driven by native scroll via the same render() rAF loop.
      //  - null   = reduced-motion: static fully-expanded column, no scroll work.
      function stackModeWant() {

          window.matchMedia('(min-width: 880px)').matches &&
          window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches &&
          !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches &&
          window.innerHeight >= 640;

      function smooth01(t) { t = t < 0 ? 0 : t > 1 ? 1 : t; return t * t * (3 - 2 * t); }

      // Per-panel expansion 0..1. Panel i rises exactly as panel i-1 falls, so
      // the open panel cross-fades into the next in order. The last panel holds
      // open through the end of the pinned range.
      function panelE(p, i, n) {
        var seg = 1 / n;
        var riseA = (i === 0) ? 0.02 : (i * seg + 0.01);
        var riseB = riseA + seg * 0.55;
        var fallA = (i + 1) * seg + 0.01;
        var fallB = fallA + seg * 0.55;
        if (i === n - 1) { fallA = 1.6; fallB = 1.8; }
        var up = smooth01((p - riseA) / (riseB - riseA));
        var dn = 1 - smooth01((p - fallA) / (fallB - fallA));
        var e = up < dn ? up : dn;
        return e < 0 ? 0 : e > 1 ? 1 : e;

          stackItems[i].h = inEl ? inEl.getBoundingClientRect().height : 0;

      // position so the heading rests near the bottom of the stage at p=0.
      // Must run with html.stack-pin already applied.
      function measureMerge() {
        if (!stackStage || !stackHead || !stackSticky) return;
        stackStage.style.transform = 'none';            // measure seated position
        var sR = stackSticky.getBoundingClientRect();
        var hR = stackHead.getBoundingClientRect();
        var restBottom = Math.max(56, Math.round(sR.height * 0.07));
        stageY0 = (sR.height - restBottom - hR.height) - (hR.top - sR.top);
        if (stageY0 < 0) stageY0 = 0;
        stackStage.style.transform = '';
        stackStage.style.setProperty('--stage-y0', stageY0.toFixed(1) + 'px');

      function applyStack(p) {
        if (stackFill) stackFill.style.transform = 'scaleY(' + p.toFixed(4) + ')';

          it.panel.style.setProperty('--e', e.toFixed(4));

          it.reveal.style.opacity = smooth01(e).toFixed(3);

      // viewport's middle band (0.82vh down to 0.40vh). Expansion is monotonic
      // with scroll and holds open once passed, so bars expand in turn and stay.
      // Read every rect first, then write, to avoid per-frame layout thrash.
      function applyStackFlow(vh) {
        var start = vh * 0.82, end = vh * 0.40, span = (start - end) || 1;
        var es = [];
        for (var i = 0; i < stackItems.length; i++) {
          var top = stackItems[i].panel.getBoundingClientRect().top;
          es[i] = smooth01((start - top) / span);
        }
        for (var j = 0; j < stackItems.length; j++) {
          var it = stackItems[j];
          it.panel.style.setProperty('--e', es[j].toFixed(4));
          it.reveal.style.height = (it.h * es[j]).toFixed(1) + 'px';
          it.reveal.style.opacity = es[j].toFixed(3);
        }
      }

      function setupStack() {
        if (!stackTrack || !stackList) return;
        if (!stackItems.length) {
          stackList.querySelectorAll('.stack-panel').forEach(function (panel) {
            stackItems.push({
              panel: panel,
              reveal: panel.querySelector('.stack-reveal'),
              inEl: panel.querySelector('.stack-reveal-in'),
              h: 0
            });
          });
          stackN = stackItems.length;
        }
        var mode = stackModeWant();
        var root = document.documentElement;
        root.classList.remove('stack-pin', 'stack-flow');
        if (stackStage) { stackStage.style.removeProperty('--stage-y0'); stackStage.style.removeProperty('--reveal'); }
        if (heroStage)  { heroStage.style.removeProperty('--hx'); heroStage.classList.remove('is-gone'); }
        function clearPanels() {
          for (var j = 0; j < stackItems.length; j++) {
            stackItems[j].panel.style.removeProperty('--e');
            stackItems[j].panel.style.removeProperty('--in');
            if (stackItems[j].reveal) {
              stackItems[j].reveal.style.height = '';
              stackItems[j].reveal.style.opacity = '';
            }
          }
        }
        if (mode === 'pin') {
          root.classList.add('stack-pin');
          var vh = window.innerHeight;
          stackRange = Math.round((REVEAL_VH + stackN * PANEL_VH) * vh);
          revealEnd  = REVEAL_VH / (REVEAL_VH + stackN * PANEL_VH);
          stackTrack.style.height = (vh + stackRange) + 'px';
          measureStack();
          applyStack(0);   // compress panels to rest state before measuring stage height (resize-mid-accordion guard, Fable check nit 1)
          measureMerge();

          stackMode = 'pin';
        } else if (mode === 'flow') {
          root.classList.add('stack-flow');
          stackTrack.style.height = '';   // panels flow at natural height

          measureStack();                 // measure reveal-in natural heights
          stackMode = 'flow';
        } else {

      function maxScroll() {
        var h = Math.max(
          document.body.scrollHeight, document.documentElement.scrollHeight,
          document.body.offsetHeight, document.documentElement.offsetHeight
        );
        return Math.max(0, h - window.innerHeight);
      }

      // paint all scroll-driven effects from the current scroll position
      function render() {
        var sy = window.pageYOffset || document.documentElement.scrollTop || 0;
        var vh = window.innerHeight;

        if (progress && !reduce) {
          var ms = maxScroll();
          progress.style.transform = 'scaleX(' + (ms > 0 ? Math.min(1, sy / ms) : 0) + ')';
        }

        if (reduce) return;

        // hero instrument: anchored at the top of the page. Drift grows with
        // scroll for depth; skip the work once it is well off-screen.
        if (heroEls.length && sy < vh * 1.6) {
          for (var i = 0; i < heroEls.length; i++) {
            heroEls[i].el.style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + (sy * heroEls[i].speed).toFixed(1) + 'px,0)';
          }
        }

        // CTA mark: parallax relative to the section passing through the viewport
        if (ctaEls.length && ctaSection) {
          var r = ctaSection.getBoundingClientRect();
          if (r.bottom > -50 && r.top < vh + 50) {
            var p = (r.top + r.height / 2 - vh / 2);
            for (var j = 0; j < ctaEls.length; j++) {
              ctaEls[j].el.style.transform = 'translate3d(0,' + (p * -ctaEls[j].speed).toFixed(1) + 'px,0)';
            }
          }
        }

        // signature scroll-stack: progress across the pinned track drives the
        // sequential expand. sp<0 (entering) = all compressed; sp>1 = last open.
        if (stackMode === 'pin' && stackRange > 0) {
          var sp = (sy - stackTop) / stackRange;
          sp = sp < 0 ? 0 : sp > 1 ? 1 : sp;

          // phase 1 — hero recede + pillar reveal (sp in [0, revealEnd])
          var rv = smooth01(sp / revealEnd);
          var hx = smooth01(sp / (revealEnd * HERO_LEAD));
          if (heroStage) {
            heroStage.style.setProperty('--hx', hx.toFixed(4));
            heroStage.classList.toggle('is-gone', hx > 0.995);
          }
          if (stackStage) stackStage.style.setProperty('--reveal', rv.toFixed(4));
          for (var k = 0; k < stackItems.length; k++) {
            stackItems[k].panel.style.setProperty('--in',
              smooth01((rv - k * 0.14) / 0.62).toFixed(4));
          }

          // phase 2 — sequential accordion (sp in [revealEnd, 1]), unchanged mechanic
          var ap = (sp - revealEnd) / (1 - revealEnd);
          applyStack(ap < 0 ? 0 : ap > 1 ? 1 : ap);
        } else if (stackMode === 'flow') {
          applyStackFlow(vh);
        }
      }

      // ----- inertia smooth-scroll (desktop pointer only) -----
      var wantSmooth = !reduce &&
        window.matchMedia('(pointer: fine)').matches &&
        !window.matchMedia('(pointer: coarse)').matches;

      var target = 0, current = 0, running = false;
      var EASE = 0.12;

      function clamp(v) { return Math.max(0, Math.min(v, maxScroll())); }

      function loop() {
        var diff = target - current;
        if (Math.abs(diff) < 0.4) {
          current = target;
          window.scrollTo(0, current);
          render();
          running = false;
          return;
        }
        current += diff * EASE;
        window.scrollTo(0, current);
        render();
        requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
      function startLoop() { if (!running) { running = true; requestAnimationFrame(loop); } }

      function onWheel(e) {
        if (e.ctrlKey) return; // let pinch-zoom through
        if (e.target && e.target.closest && e.target.closest('.nav-drawer, [data-scroll-native]')) return;
        if (maxScroll() <= 0) return;
        var dy = e.deltaY;
        if (e.deltaMode === 1) dy *= 16;                    // lines -> px
        else if (e.deltaMode === 2) dy *= window.innerHeight; // pages -> px
        e.preventDefault();
        target = clamp(target + dy);
        startLoop();
      }

      // resync when scroll changes by other means (keyboard, scrollbar drag,
      // browser find) so the lerp never fights the browser.
      function onSmoothScroll() {
        if (running) return;
        var sy = window.pageYOffset;
        if (Math.abs(sy - current) > 2) { current = target = sy; render(); }
      }

      function smoothTo(y) { target = clamp(y); startLoop(); }

      function bindAnchors() {
        document.querySelectorAll('a[href^="#"]').forEach(function (a) {
          a.addEventListener('click', function (e) {
            var id = a.getAttribute('href');
            if (!id || id === '#') return;
            var t = document.querySelector(id);
            if (!t) return;
            e.preventDefault();
            var y = t.getBoundingClientRect().top + window.pageYOffset - 70; // clear fixed nav

      var ticking = false;
      function onNativeScroll() {
        if (!ticking) { ticking = true; requestAnimationFrame(function () { render(); ticking = false; }); }

      if (wantSmooth) {
        document.documentElement.classList.add('lenis-on');
        current = target = window.pageYOffset || 0;
        window.addEventListener('wheel', onWheel, { passive: false });
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onSmoothScroll, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () { target = clamp(target); render(); }, { passive: true });

      } else {
        window.addEventListener('scroll', onNativeScroll, { passive: true });
        window.addEventListener('resize', render, { passive: true });

      // stack geometry depends on viewport + content height; (re)build it on
      // load, on resize (debounced), and once web fonts settle (they change
      // the measured panel heights).
      setupStack();

      var stackRT;
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () {

            measureMerge();
            stackTop = stackTrack.getBoundingClientRect().top + (window.pageYOffset || 0);
          } else if (stackMode === 'flow') {
            measureStack();
          }
          render();
        });
      }

      window.addEventListener('load', function () { setupStack(); render(); });
      render();
    })();

        document.body.style.position = '';
        document.body.style.top = '';

      hamburger.addEventListener('click', openDrawer);
      if (closeBtn) closeBtn.addEventListener('click', closeDrawer);

      // Skip on slow connections / save-data
      var conn = navigator.connection || navigator.mozConnection || navigator.webkitConnection;
      var slow = conn && (conn.saveData || /^(slow-2g|2g|3g)$/i.test(conn.effectiveType || ''));
      if (slow) return;

      // Skip if user prefers reduced motion
      if (window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches) return;

      // Single hero video: lab environment in motion (2026-05-26). Source +
      // poster set in the HTML; JS just kicks off playback when in view.
      // (Prior rotation between two memory-recall clips was retired when
      // those moved to the /plugin page hero.)

      function play() {
        v.preload = 'auto';
        v.load();
        var p = v.play();
        if (p && typeof p.catch === 'function') p.catch(function() {});
      }

      // Defer the actual fetch + play until the video is in view. On desktop
      // it sits in the hero next to the headline (already visible) so plays
      // right away. On mobile it stacks below the text, so we wait until
      // the user scrolls it into view. No wasted cellular bandwidth, no
      // playback under the fold.
      if ('IntersectionObserver' in window) {
        var io = new IntersectionObserver(function(entries) {
          entries.forEach(function(e) {

              io.unobserve(v);

        io.observe(v);
      } else {
        play();

              p.setAttribute('hidden', '');
              p.removeAttribute('data-active');
            }
          });
          if (indicator && buttons[idx]) {
            var btn = buttons[idx];
            var btnLeft = btn.offsetLeft;
            indicator.style.width = btn.offsetWidth + 'px';
            indicator.style.transform = 'translateX(' + btnLeft + 'px)';
          }
        }

        buttons.forEach(function (b, i) {
          b.addEventListener('click', function () { move(i); });
          b.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
            if (e.key === 'ArrowRight' || e.key === 'ArrowDown') {
              e.preventDefault();
              var next = (i + 1) % buttons.length;
              move(next);
              buttons[next].focus();
            } else if (e.key === 'ArrowLeft' || e.key === 'ArrowUp') {
              e.preventDefault();
              var prev = (i - 1 + buttons.length) % buttons.length;
              move(prev);
              buttons[prev].focus();
            } else if (e.key === 'Home') {
              e.preventDefault(); move(0); buttons[0].focus();
            } else if (e.key === 'End') {
              e.preventDefault(); move(buttons.length - 1); buttons[buttons.length - 1].focus();
            }
          });
        });

        var initialize = function () { move(0); };
        if (document.readyState === 'complete') initialize();
        else window.addEventListener('load', initialize);

        var resizeTimer;
        window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
          clearTimeout(resizeTimer);
          resizeTimer = setTimeout(function () {
            var activeIdx = 0;
            buttons.forEach(function (b, i) { if (b.getAttribute('aria-selected') === 'true') activeIdx = i; });
            move(activeIdx);
          }, 120);
        });
      });
    })();
  </script>


  <!-- ========== THEME TOGGLE (light/dark) ========== -->
  <script>
    (function () {
      var root = document.documentElement;
      var toggles = [document.getElementById('theme-toggle'), document.getElementById('theme-toggle-drawer')].filter(Boolean);
      if (!toggles.length) return;
      var themeMeta = document.querySelector('meta[name="theme-color"]');

      function syncState() {
        var isDark = root.classList.contains('dark');
        toggles.forEach(function (btn) {
          btn.setAttribute('aria-pressed', isDark ? 'true' : 'false');
          btn.setAttribute('aria-label', isDark ? 'Switch to light mode' : 'Switch to dark mode');
        });
        if (themeMeta) themeMeta.setAttribute('content', isDark ? '#100d07' : '#f5f1e6');
      }

      function toggleTheme() {
        var isDark = root.classList.toggle('dark');
        try { localStorage.setItem('sibyl-theme', isDark ? 'dark' : 'light'); } catch (e) {}
        syncState();
      }

      toggles.forEach(function (btn) { btn.addEventListener('click', toggleTheme); });
      // Reflect the theme the no-flash head script already applied
      syncState();
    })();
  </script>
